redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.description: Manage inbound links, review URL changes, and find missing pages.
redirects.failed: Could not load or save redirects.
redirects.help: Exact paths take priority, then longest prefixes, then regex. Prefixes end in / and expose the suffix as $1. Regex supports ^/old/([^/]+)$, digit captures (\d+), and a final (.*). Use $1–$9 in targets. Platform routes take precedence; managed rules override public content. Incoming query strings are dropped, except ?p= content identities.
redirects.csvHelp: Import up to 500 rows (1 MiB). The whole import is rejected if any row is invalid or duplicated. Export for the required header: source,kind,targetType,target,status,enabled.
redirects.tooLarge: CSV files must be 1 MiB or smaller.
redirects.suggestionsHelp: Slug and permalink changes already have automatic 301 redirects. Review a historical URL to create a managed rule with your chosen status and target. Disabling that rule restores automatic permalink handling.
redirects.logHelp: Up to 10,000 paths, retained for 30 days. Hit counts and the latest referrer are recorded; query strings and IP addresses are not stored. Logging is best effort under heavy traffic.
